## Libraries

```{r}

library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(scales)
library(ggplot2)
```


## Plot colors
```{r colors and order, include=FALSE}
treat.colors <- c("control"  = "darkseagreen" , "chicken"= "royalblue1", "cow" = "red3","pellet"= "darkorchid1","compost"="chocolate4")

time.colors <- c("#BFD3E6", "#9ECAE1", "#6BAED6", "#4292C6", "#2171B5", "#08519C")


treat.order  <- c("control",  "chicken", "cow","compost", "pellet")

treat.colors_ok <- c("Control"  = "darkseagreen" , "Chicken\nmanure"= "royalblue1", "Cow\nmanure" = "red3","Pelletised\ncompost"= "darkorchid1","Compost"="chocolate4")
```



## Load data

```{r}
zotu97 <- import_qiime(
  "01_Raw_data/p1031_run231023_ITS_ccs_ZOTU_c97_Count_Sintax.txt"
)

metadata <- read.csv(
  "01_Raw_data/metadata_2025.csv") %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "sample_name")

zotu97 <- merge_phyloseq(zotu97, sample_data(metadata))
```

## Initial exploration of the data

```{r}
n1 <- sum(otu_table(zotu97)) # Number of reads 1561802

n_taxa <- ntaxa(zotu97) #1641


## remove singletons
zotu97 <- prune_taxa(rowSums(otu_table(zotu97)) > 1, zotu97)

n2 <- sum(otu_table(zotu97)) #1561772

n1-n2 # 30 singletons removed

missing_samples <- setdiff(rownames(metadata), sample_names(zotu97))
missing_samples #0


#numeric 
number_sequences_perSample <- sample_sums(zotu97)

mean(number_sequences_perSample) #17353.02
median(number_sequences_perSample) #14172
min(number_sequences_perSample) #5314
max(number_sequences_perSample) #54616
sd(number_sequences_perSample) #9951.012
```



## Sequencing run checks

```{r Sequencing depth z97 , include=FALSE}

seqdepth97 <- colSums(otu_table(zotu97)) #get the number of sequences(or reads) per sample
sample.table97 <- sample_data(zotu97)

sample.table97 <- cbind(seq.depth= seqdepth97, sample.table97) 

table_resume_depth <-sample.table97 %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_depth = mean(seq.depth),
    min_depth  = min(seq.depth),
    max_depth  = max(seq.depth),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


sample.table97 <- sample.table97 %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = treat.order))

df_depth <- sample.table97 %>%
  mutate(
    rep       = factor(rep, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
    time      = factor(time),
    treatment = as.factor(treatment)
  )


p_depth <- ggplot(df_depth, aes(x = rep, y = seq.depth, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.2)+
  facet_grid(time ~ treatment, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", switch = "y", labeller = labeller(
      treatment = c(
        "control" = "Control",
        "chicken"     = "Chicken\nmanure",
        "cow"         = "Cow\nmanure",
        "compost"     = "Compost",
        "pellet"      = "Pelletised\ncompost"
      ))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = treat.colors, breaks = treat.order,
    labels = treat.labels)+
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "ITS Sequencing depth (reads)",
    fill = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    strip.placement   = "outside",
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 0.3))


p_depth

ggsave(p_depth, file= "04_Figures/SupplementaryFigure1_ITS.png", width= 1900,height= 1200, units= "px")

rm(p_depth)

saveRDS(p_depth, file = '03_Analysis_files/Supplementary_plot/Supplementary1_ITS.rds')
```


## Rarefaction curves


```{r}
trans_zotu97 <- t(otu_table(zotu97)) %>% data.frame() #transpose the otu table

rarecurve97 <- rarecurve(trans_zotu97, step=200, tidy= TRUE)


names(rarecurve97) <- c("Sample", "Reads", "Species")

metadata <- metadata %>% rownames_to_column(var= "Sample")


rarecurve_meta <- rarecurve97 %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "Sample")

rarefaction_treatment <- rarecurve_meta %>% ggplot(aes(Reads, Species, col= treatment, group = Sample))+
  geom_line()+
  scale_color_manual(values = treat.colors, labels= treat.labels, breaks = treat.order)+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(x= "Sequencing depth",
       y= "ITS Number of OTUs",
       col= "Treatment")

ggsave(rarefaction_treatment, file= "04_Figures/SupplementaryFigure2_ITS.png", width= 1900,height= 1200, units= "px")


saveRDS(rarefaction_treatment, file = '03_Analysis_files/Supplementary_plot/Supplementary2_ITS.rds')
```

## Taxonomy

```{r}
## 1) Normalise to relative abundance
physeq_norm<-  transform_sample_counts(zotu97, function(x) x / sum(x) )
## 2) Collapse to Phylum
dat_merge   <- tax_glom(physeq = physeq_norm, "Phylum", NArm = FALSE)

molten      <- psmelt(dat_merge)

## 3) Cluster per mean and collapse to less than 2%
agg <- molten %>%
  group_by(treatment, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Taxonomy = case_when(
      is.na(Phylum)        ~ "Unassigned",
      Abundance < 0.02     ~ "Less than 2%",
      TRUE                 ~ as.character(Phylum)
    ),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = treat.order, labels = treat.labels)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Taxonomy = recode(
      Taxonomy,
      "Mortierellomycota" = "Mucoromycota"
    )
  )

## 4) Regroup
agg2 <- agg %>%
  group_by(treatment, Taxonomy) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  mutate(Abundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup()

## 5) Order taxa by total abundance, keeping Unassigned and Less than 2% at the bottom
tax_order <- agg2 %>%
  group_by(Taxonomy) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  pull(Taxonomy)

final_levels <- c(
  "Unassigned",
  "Less than 2%",
  setdiff(tax_order, c("Unassigned", "Less than 2%"))
)

agg2 <- agg2 %>%
  mutate(
    Taxonomy = factor(Taxonomy, levels = final_levels)
  )

## Check totals
agg_check <- agg2 %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

agg_check

## Palette with updated names
phylum.pal <- c(
  "Ascomycota"     = "#A8D1BC",
  "Basidiomycota"  = "#F7C4B4",
  "Glomeromycota"  = "#B0E0F4",
  "Mucoromycota"   = "#D7C9E8",
  "Less than 2%"   = "#F9E77F",
  "Unassigned"     = "gray30"
)

setdiff(unique(agg2$Taxonomy), names(phylum.pal))

p_phyla2 <- ggplot(agg2, aes(x = 1, y = Abundance, fill = Taxonomy)) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.6,
    color = "grey44",
    linewidth = 0.05,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  facet_grid(. ~ treatment, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum.pal) +
  labs(y = "Relative abundance (%) Fungi", x = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    axis.text.x       = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x      = element_blank(),
    strip.placement   = "outside",
    strip.text.x.top  = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5),
    panel.spacing.x   = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend("Taxonomy", nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))

p_phyla2
ggsave(p_phyla2, file= "04_Figures/SupplementaryFigure3_ITS_leyenda.png", width= 1900,height= 1200, units= "px")


saveRDS(p_phyla2, file = '03_Analysis_files/Supplementary_plot/Supplementary3_ITS.rds')
```
